data.content_ref: inline:The target proposes 'exponential' attention scaling with duration but provides no justification for why exponential—rather than linear, polynomial, or logarithmic—is the appropriate functional form. Its own countercondition concedes the proposal may cause 'pathological oscillation' where the system 'alternately abandons all new generation to retire a backlog, and then swings back to unchecked generation,' yet the target offers no damping mechanism or guardrail to prevent this admitted failure mode. The claim that an equilibrium will be 'stable' is numerically testable but no sandboxed simulation is proposed, and no evidence block ids ground the characterization of the current mechanism.
